UNZIP(1L)                                                          UNZIP(1L)

SYNOPSIS
     unzip [-Z] [-cflptuvz] file[.zip] [-x xfile(s) ...] [-d exdir]

ARGUMENTS
     [-d exdir]
            Extract the files into the directory exdir.

     [-x xfile(s)]
            Leave out the archive members xfile(s).

OPTIONS
     -l     List the archive's files.
